initial: Use case: historical-scene. Asset: one transparent-background game lobby illustration for a Korean history education app. Draw a compact floating cutout diorama, landscape 4:3 composition, entire scene within image with a narrow transparent margin. Style matches Westory notice-board characters: very cute 2.5-head-tall Korean chibi adults, rounded rosy faces, small black expressive eyes, thick dark-brown clean outlines, polished soft cel shading and watercolor-like details, friendly focused expressions. Bright and beautifully readable at 420px, high quality in-game 2D art, not photographic or 3D plastic. No text, labels, UI, title, logo or border. True transparent alpha around the outside silhouette of the architecture, characters and a small ground island. Daylit light blue, muted jade and warm ivory palette with charcoal black hats; traditional gray-blue Korean curved tiled roof and plain wooden columns. All writing implements strictly Joseon: large off-white flat fibrous hanji paper, thin bamboo-handled pointed dark ink brush held nearly upright with the brush tip touching paper, small rectangular black stone inkstone with ink well, separate solid black ink stick, modest porcelain water dropper. Only a few thin vertical ink marks on paper, no legible fake text. Candidates sitting cross-legged or kneeling on woven straw mats with hanji before them; no chairs, modern pens, pencils, bound notebooks, glasses, umbrellas, phones, modern uniforms or graduation regalia. Young adult male candidates wearing plain unpatterned long loose dark blue-gray robes with white under-collar and simple black soft scholar cloth caps (yeondugeon), NOT winged official samo hats, no rank badges, no embroidered dragons on candidates, no awarded flowers. Foreground characters large and charming, one unobstructed brush-writing hand and inkstone clearly visible, correct hand anatomy. Scene: CHOSI provincial examination in a local Korean county setting, early Joseon. Three candidates writing earnestly at some distance from each other on mats, the main candidate in front in slate-blue robe. Behind them a modest single-story local government examination courtyard hall with gray tiled roof and wooden pillars, low earth-and-tile wall, small green pine and gentle countryside hills. A rural small-scale setting, no royal palace throne or king. Architecture stays secondary behind the large foreground writers. One cohesive compact cutout landscape diorama.
